sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Klondike Solitaire Paradise is a classic card game that involves moving cards from a tableau to a foundation pile in ascending order. The game starts with a random deck of cards, which are dealt into a tableau of seven columns. The foundation pile is an empty pile that players must move cards to in order to win the game. The game also features a draw pile, which contains cards that players can draw from to add to the tableau or foundation pile.

Players can move cards from the tableau to the foundation pile in ascending order, with cards of the same suit following each other in order. For example, a 3 of hearts can be moved on top of a 2 of hearts, but a 5 of diamonds cannot be moved on top of a 3 of hearts. Players can also move cards from the tableau to the draw pile, and draw new cards from the draw pile to add to the tableau or foundation pile.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging, requiring players to think strategically and make use of the available cards in the draw pile. With each level, the game becomes increasingly challenging, requiring players to think more critically and make more strategic moves in order to win.
